verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Canny that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server lets external LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor) query and act on Canny data, but the assistant there is the external host, not a product-native assistant. Autopilot is a built-in automated feedback-capture pipeline, not a general assistant users hand tasks to, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
